description:
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Lore Weaver by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat.
